title: Fulfillment Available Method
description: Inventory availability hint for a fulfillment method type.

type.description: Fulfillment method type this availability applies to. Well-known values: `delivery`, `pickup`. Businesses MAY use additional values.

scheduling.description: Scheduling capability supported for this fulfillment method type. Well-known values: `asap_only` (immediate ordering only), `scheduled_only` (advance scheduled time slots only), `asap_and_scheduled` (both). Businesses MAY use additional values; a Platform MUST NOT reject the containing object for an unrecognized value and SHOULD treat it as if `scheduling` were absent.

fulfillable_on.description: 'now' for immediate availability, or an RFC 3339 timestamp from which the method becomes available (e.g., delivery starting at dinner service).

description.description: Human-readable availability info (e.g., 'Available for pickup at restaurant today after 5pm').
